headline: Executive order signed September 30, 2025, aims to use artificial intelligence to help research cures for childhood cancer.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs the federal government to use artificial intelligence to support research into cancers that affect children. No official summary was provided, so the specific actions, agencies, funding, and deadlines involved are not known from the available information.

who_it_affects.group: Children with cancer and their families
who_it_affects.how: The order is aimed at speeding up research that could lead to new treatments for childhood cancers.
Researchers may see new federal efforts to apply artificial intelligence to their work, though details are not given in the title.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed September 30, 2025; specific deadlines are not stated in the available information.
